cohort: The study evaluated responses generated by ChatGPT and Google Gemini to patient questions on obstetrical and gynecologic topics, with these responses assessed by board-certified Obstetrics and Gynecology physicians.
finding: Both ChatGPT and Google Gemini provided largely accurate and complete responses to patient questions, with ChatGPT demonstrating stronger overall outcomes in accuracy and completeness.
cross-section timing: The evaluation of AI model responses was performed at a single point in time.
